chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: John Simmen at the Amsterdam Club and the Band Box that stole electricity
summary: Danny first met John Simmen of Switzerland at an Amsterdam Club rehearsal, and recalls the Band Box owner who stole power from Edison on 130th Street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: John Simmen. He was there. First time I met him. They had brought him in there (I was making a rehearsal) for somebody, to make some record. That was the Band Box...no, not the Band Box, the Amsterdam Club. Then Bert... I can't think of this guy's name. He was a trumpet player, and he owned the Band Box. He was a West Indian. And he got smart. He went up and got up on an electric light post, and hooked up some gimmick on there for stealing electricity from Edison, and lit up his place, had it all lit up, you know, and get the people come in and see (?) with all that power. Something to do with them boxes up
there. Then they sued him, and almost...I think they sent him to jail or something. But he was taking...
The Band Box was on 130th Street, right around Connie's Inn.

Right around the corner from Connie's Inn. In the back of the (?) was started(?) the last year or something. All the (?)s were right on that corner. The Tree of Hope, (?) went crazy there for years. Connie's Inn. (?) be at the Alley Way outside...
Sure. Right in front of Connie's Inn.
